data.name: BlueGreen
data.description: BlueGreen Water Technologies is a US-headquartered (Israel R&D) environmental technology company whose primary business is remediating harmful algal blooms in freshwater bodies using its EPA-registered Lake Guard® formulations and BGi monitoring platform. The company also generates Net Blue™ carbon credits under the SOCIALCARBON standard as an adjacent revenue stream, with first issuance of ~12,913 tonnes in April 2024. Recent activity in 2025 includes a Winrock International partnership, a Houston office opening, a new CIO appointment, and a peer-reviewed validation study.
